judged.play: LOUD gets a double kill on Split to win the round
judged.reason: A routine enemy round win with a standard disbelieving reaction.

judged.play: Replay of Cryo pulling off a fast Operator flick headshot
judged.line: GET HIM OUT OF HERE! Look at that flick bro!
judged.reason: Cryo's incredible Operator flick replay prompts an enthusiastic reaction.

judged.play: Pre-round scoreboard display while streamer discusses player stats
judged.reason: Casual pre-round banter without any play on screen.

judged.play: Replay showing a player getting stunned by utility and still landing an Operator headshot kill
judged.line: GET HIM OUT OF HERE! No he won't!
judged.reason: His funny rant about how absurd it is to hit a headshot while stunned makes this play standout.

judged.play: Timeout screen while casters talk about LOUD stats and streamer jokes about home crowd advantage
judged.reason: A somewhat amusing observation during a timeout, but lacks any gameplay action.

judged.play: 100 Thieves secures a 2v3 site hold to take round 20
judged.reason: A solid round win, but fairly standard compared to the match-climaxing moments later.

judged.play: 100T executes a clean round win right after LOUD calls a timeout
judged.reason: Decent banter taunting the opponent's failed timeout strategy.

judged.play: 100T wins round 22 to reach map point at 12-10
judged.reason: High-stakes round victory that gets a big head-clutching reaction, but outshone by the final map win.

judged.play: Replay of Bang securing a multi-kill in a previous round
judged.reason: Good highlight replay reaction, though similar hype repeats throughout the stream.

judged.play: 100T takes a timeout on map point
judged.reason: Streamer shows support by tugging his 100T hoodie during a pause, but no gameplay occurs.

judged.play: Asuna clutches the final 1v1 to secure map 2 for 100 Thieves 13-11
judged.line: COME ON! LET'S GO! OH MY GOODNESS!
judged.reason: The map-winning clutch moment where he explodes with excitement and grabs his figurine to celebrate.

judged.play: Replay of the match-winning clutch with streamer taunting the opponent's ultimate usage
judged.line: Get him out of here! We don't care what ult you're using!
judged.reason: A high-energy post-match victory celebration taunting the opponent's failed ultimate.
